title: SuperFans
tagline: Connect with your superfans. Subscription model app for football clubs.

prizes.placement: Best use of Polygon ID to preserve user privacy
prizes.title: Best use of Polygon ID to preserve user privacy

description:
An DApp with a subscription model to connect football players from Chilliz network with their fans 

It is a nice place for fans to get more intimate relationship with their football idols. It's a useful and beautiful usecase for Chiliz tokens.
